note: #2556: uneven load for every scaling bench, read by shapes.mjs. These numbers are judgement, not data: their job is to be uneven in the right ways (a few agents make most acts, agents act in runs and then pause, people arrive and leave in waves, crowds gather in one place, many react at once) and to be repeatable, not to be exact. Every number sits in a {value, source} pair whose source names where it came from or says 'estimate'. Change a number here, with evidence, never in a bench. Times are seconds.

uniform.about: today's even load: the soul-eval paced loop (--act-sec), every joined Soul acting at the same pace, to places around the map, for the whole window

presence.source: tools/playtest/eval/load.mjs pacedLoop: every joined Soul's agent acts

actSec.source: estimate: the documented example pace (docs/testing/soul-eval.md, `load --act-sec 10`); a bench passes its own --act-sec

gapShare.source: tools/playtest/eval/load.mjs pacedLoop (#2437): first act at U(0, actSec), then each gap actSec x U(0.5, 1.5)

gatheredShare.source: tools/playtest/eval/load.mjs PACED_WORDS: walk targets are named places around the map

mix.source: tools/playtest/eval/load.mjs PACED_WORDS (#2437): of its 12 words, 7 are places to walk to (bandstand, windmill, fire circle, lake, library, garden, pond), then sit on the floor, eat, read, bench (sit) and music; the word-to-kind mapping is the lane's estimate

everyday.about: a quiet day: a quarter of the joined Souls' agents active, heavy-tailed rates, acts in runs then a pause, spread out

medianSec.source: estimate: one act per 30 s for the median agent

sigma.source: estimate: chosen so the busiest tenth of agents make about half of all acts

minSec.source: estimate: no agent is offered more than one act per 2 s

runActs.source: estimate: a run is 1 to 4 acts

runGapSec.source: profiles/cadence.json real.gapS: the live agents' act-to-act gaps cluster at 2 to 4 s (p10 2.2 s, p25 3.7 s) and at 60 to 75 s (p50 61.6 s, p90 73.0 s)

pauseShare.source: estimate: each pause is the one that keeps the agent's rate, times U(0.5, 1.5)

time.firstAct: profiles/cadence.json real.firstActS (an arrival's first act, median 7.4 s); at the window's start an agent is part way through its cycle

gatheredShare.source: estimate: on a quiet day walk targets are spread around the map

mix.source: the uniform shape's mix (the paced loop's), as #2556 gives it

event.about: a live event: most agents active, the same heavy-tailed runs, arrivals in a ramp and waves of people leaving and returning, crowd moments, gathered at one named place, social acts

runGapSec.source: profiles/cadence.json real.gapS, as in the everyday shape

time.firstAct: profiles/cadence.json real.firstActS, as in the everyday shape

startShare.source: estimate: half of the present agents are there from the start

rampSec.source: estimate: the other half arrive in the first 2 minutes

maxPerSec.source: estimate: at most 2 arrivals in any one second

waveEverySec.source: estimate: every 5 minutes some leave and others return

waveShare.source: estimate: a tenth of the present agents leave in each wave, as many absent ones return

waveSpreadSec.source: estimate: a wave's leaving and returning is spread over 30 s

gapSec.source: estimate: something happens at random gaps of 45 to 120 s

share.source: estimate: 30 % of the present agents react

withinSec.source: estimate: each reaction is due within 2 s of the moment

gatheredShare.source: estimate: 60 % of walk targets are near one named place (the bench's meetup place)

mix.source: estimate: #2556's social mix (30 % speech, 15 % gestures, 15 % sitting, 30 % short walks, 10 % other); the split of 'other' into read, eat and music is the lane's estimate
